_meta.authority: Source of truth for the RCN Tools and Methods storefront and for how tools/ is organized. See docs/rcn-toolshelf-plan.html and docs/rcn-pathways.html.

statusKey.live: In use. Works, and someone other than the author could open it today.
statusKey.draft: Exists and runs, but unfinished or undocumented. Not yet offered.
statusKey.dormant: Not on the shelf. Reference, back office, superseded, or scratch.

_meta.statusesAreProposals: Every status below is Claude's reading of the repo on 2026-08-17 and awaits Marc's confirmation. Correct them here, not in the README.

shelfKey.workshop: Kept, but not on the shelf

_meta.shelvesAre: Marc's Six Nested Questions, from RCN Modeling Theory — not an invented list. A tool may sit on several shelves; shelf is a property here, never a folder on disk.
_meta.governedBy: Every use of every tool below is subject to the two governing models: the Social Action Tetrahedron (POIA) and Beauty/Good/Truth/Economy. 'All the models below these two must be informed by these or they will lead to no good.'
_meta.familyKey: Optional grouping for tools that ship as a product family, orthogonal to shelf.
_meta.paths: launch/intro/manual/example/deck are relative to tools/ unless they contain a slash.
_meta.generator: catalog.js is GENERATED from this file plus methods.json by build-catalog.js. Edit this file, then run: node tools/build-catalog.js. Nothing rebuilds it for you — index.html only ever reads the generated catalog.js, because a browser will not fetch() a local .json from file://. Run `node tools/build-catalog.js --check` to fail loudly if they have diverged.

tools.name: RCN NDC Map
tools.what: See where the neighborhood development cooperatives are, and what is happening in each place.
tools.note: Live site is two files in one flat folder — rcn_map.html plus rcn_static_data.js loaded by flat name. The standalone build is a handout, explicitly not the live site.

tools.name: Issue Polygon Map
tools.what: Draw and name the parcels an issue actually covers, then share a link straight to one of them.

tools.name: RCN Timeline
tools.what: Lay events out in time and test whether the order people remember actually holds.

tools.name: RCN Graph Tool
tools.what: Draw a system as nodes and edges, then argue about it together.
tools.note: Filename stem disagrees with its intro and manual (graph-tool-v22 vs graph-tool-*). Rename opportunistically, not in a sweep. Modes answer different questions: CLD is Why, EIP is How-strategy, OPM and SFD are How-mechanism.

tools.name: Vester Influence Analysis
tools.what: Find which variables actually drive a system, given its feedback structure — without needing numbers.
tools.note: The only tool with a build step (Vite/React). Steps 0-5 built, through Partial Scenario simulation.

tools.name: RCN Schema Sunburst
tools.what: See a whole schema at once, and find where a concept sits inside it.

tools.name: SODOTO Issuer
tools.what: Vouch for someone who has learned a skill, and sign the credential yourself.
tools.note: Live on Wiki Café. Keys never on the server — each issuer enters their seed in their own browser.

tools.name: Your SODOTO Identity
tools.what: Mint your own identity on your own device. Nobody else holds it.

tools.name: Sign Your Gate
tools.what: Sign off a learning gate — see one, do one, teach one.

tools.name: CfA-dSC Contract Creator
tools.what: Write a two-party commitment that both sides can hold each other to.

tools.name: My Support Network
tools.what: Name the people who actually help, and see the gaps.

tools.name: RCN Graph Composer
tools.what: Assemble a graph from families and schemas instead of drawing it from scratch.
tools.note: Reads families.js and graph-sets.js as flat siblings — .js not .json, so it works from file://. Do not move those.

tools.name: EIP Integration Explorer
tools.what: Walk the twelve EIP artifacts and see how they connect.
tools.note: Underscored filename. Rename to hyphens when next touched.

tools.name: Wardley Map Generator
tools.what: Place what you depend on by how evolved it is, and see what to build versus buy.

tools.name: My Health Choices
tools.what: See treatment options as a thousand dots, so the odds are something you can look at.

tools.name: NRM — Neighborhood Risk Management
tools.what: Trace how a harm actually happened, back through the barriers that failed.
tools.note: Also exists as a mode inside the Graph Tool.

tools.name: Stock & Flow — Stella Approach
tools.what: See what accumulates and what drains it, once you have earned the right to numbers.

tools.name: A3 Problem Solving
tools.what: Get a whole problem, its analysis and its countermeasure onto one sheet.
tools.note: A method wearing a tool's clothes — registry skill #15. It has ordered steps and gates, so it also wants a method page, and the two should point at each other. New, from a parallel session.

tools.name: Graph JSON to Vensim CLD
tools.what: Take a drawing out of the Graph Tool and into Vensim.

tools.name: EIP Local Finance Analysis
tools.what: See where a local economy's money comes from and where it leaves.

tools.name: RCN Process Behavior Charts
tools.what: Tell a real change from noise, so a group stops arguing about both.
tools.note: Arrived fully documented, with its own schema at schemas/rcn-spc.md. The pattern every tool should follow.

tools.name: Conversation Navigator
tools.what: Check whether a conversation is fooling itself, before acting on it.
tools.note: NAMING DRIFT: every page is titled Conversation Navigator; every filename says bias-checker. The tool was renamed and the files were not. Hosted at Wiki Café, not Firebase.

tools.name: Positive Affect Score
tools.what: Measure whether people are actually doing better, not just whether the program ran.

tools.name: eVSM Survey Cycle
tools.what: Ask a whole organization where the value stalls, then read the answers together.
tools.note: ONE entry, not four. These are stages of a single method — registry skill #14. Needs one intro for the whole cycle, not four.

tools.name: My Health Picture
tools.what: See your own health as one picture you can hand to anyone caring for you.
tools.note: Runs behind coupler-proxy.py on port 8766, with per-patient wiki routing.

tools.name: Prepare for Your Appointment
tools.what: Work out what you actually want to ask, before you are in the room.

tools.name: MORE Outliner
tools.what: Think in an outline that saves straight back into the wiki.
tools.note: Manual but no intro — the largest documentation gap on a live tool.

tools.name: Groove Workspace
tools.what: Work together in one place, and keep the trail of what was decided.
tools.note: Runs on port 3001.

tools.name: FedWiki Lineup & Print
tools.what: Capture a row of wiki pages as one thing you can send or print.

tools.name: RCN House Icon Library
tools.what: The house icons, on one sheet, for choosing from.
tools.note: Reference, not a tool.

tools.name: Patient Provisioning
tools.what: Set up a new person's wiki and seed their templates.
tools.note: Back office. Not offered on the shelf.

tools.name: IBIS Map — Health Conversation
tools.what: An argument mapped as issues, positions and arguments.
tools.note: An example, not a general tool.

tools.name: LLM Session Index
tools.what: Marc's own index of past sessions.
tools.note: Personal. `conversation_index (old).html` is a download-mangled duplicate — delete it.

tools.name: Session Instruction Builder
tools.what: Build the instruction block for a working session.
tools.note: Download-mangled filename. Rename to session-builder.html.

tools.name: Contract Creator
tools.what: An earlier contract tool.
tools.note: Probably superseded by cfa-dsc-creator. Confirm, then archive.

notOnTheShelf.comment: Files in tools/ that are not tools. Listed so the alive-or-dead call is recorded rather than re-litigated.
notOnTheShelf.modelsNote: These are PARTICULARS, in Marc's sense: 'the approach to modeling in RCN is to reveal rich perspectives in particular systems — NOT to create generalized models. Our generalizations will be published as Patterns.' They belong in models/ or tools/examples/, each linked to the pattern it was abstracted into. Only bgte-12-triples.json is loaded by path from a tool (the Graph Tool); the rest are only mentioned in manuals, so moving them costs four link fixes.
